_comment: ResQ Kenya — Firebase Realtime Database security rules. Phase 3 (B-LOW-5). Default deny at the root, then opt in per-path. Server-side writes through the Admin SDK bypass these rules; the goal here is to make client-side writes provably safe. Source: https://firebase.google.com/docs/database/security/rules-conditions

$requestId._comment: Customer (data.customerId == auth.uid) and assigned provider (data.providerId == auth.uid) may read live tracking state. All client writes are denied — Cloud Functions write through the Admin SDK so providerLocation, providerStale, updatedAt, and status flips happen server-authoritatively.

$providerId._comment: Each provider may write their own broadcast doc; nobody else may. Reads are server-only — clients should subscribe to activeRequests/{id}/providerLocation, which is filtered to the assigned customer.
